characters.name: Detective Priya Okafor
characters.description: Your assigned partner from Cadet rank onward. Sharp, patient, methodical — the kind of partner who lets you make the call and only pushes back when it matters.

characters.name: Lena Park
characters.description: ME who flags anything that doesn't sit right before she'll sign off on it. First one to call a 'probable overdose' a probable lie.

characters.name: Voss
characters.description: The name attached to the network's money. Never appears at a scene; appears in the paperwork — invoices, shell registrations, wire memos — long before appearing in person.
characters.cover_identity: Registered agent / compliance consultant for a chain of logistics and import-export shell companies — the cover that lets Voss originate the invoices and wire transfers the early breadcrumbs are built from.

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: Voss's fixer. Handles the people Boone's cleanup work leaves behind — witnesses, loose ends, anyone who needs a reason to stay quiet.

characters.name: "Boone"
characters.description: Contract cleaner. Doesn't ask who hired him and doesn't keep names — which is exactly why the network keeps hiring him. First surfaces as the guilty party in Case 30, resurfaces as a recurring obstacle afterward.

characters.name: Grant
characters.description: Shows up fast and well-briefed whenever a wrongful accusation lands — too fast, too well-briefed, for a public defender. Spawned into the world by consequence_hooks.recurring_npc_spawns.

characters.name: Reyes
characters.description: Beat-level informant whose tips are reliable about eighty percent of the time — and always worth checking before they're worth trusting.
